Yes, this feels right. Clicking the title takes me off to the actual Rome article like I'd expect, and the "Edit" button sitting right there next to it brings me back to those same fillable details — the title, description, and address all editable again. Keeping "go to the page" and "change the details" as two clearly separate things is sensible; I'd worry about accidentally opening the webpage when I only meant to fix a typo, and this avoids that.

Happy to look at the other approach you mentioned so I can compare, but on its own this one works well for me.
